input.summary: Works vest in Company on creation with an express assignment; add Company Data/pre-existing IP ownership and no joint ownership; make the embedded-Contractor-IP licence irrevocable and worldwide.
input.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for and everything we put in, so we have made ownership of the Works vest in us on creation with an express assignment rather than being conditioned on invoices having been paid (our payment protection is the fee and termination provisions, not IP title). We have also confirmed that our data and pre-existing IP remain ours with no assignment to Contractor and no joint ownership, and made the licence to Contractor's Information embedded in the Works irrevocable and worldwide so we can keep using the Works after the engagement ends.

ops.oldText: are the property of Company to the extent that such Works were created by Contractor for Company over a time period for which Company has been invoiced and said invoice has been paid.
ops.newText: are the property of Company upon creation, and Contractor hereby irrevocably assigns to Company all right, title and interest (including all intellectual property rights) in and to the Works, effective upon creation and regardless of whether any invoice for the related Services has then been issued or paid.

ops.oldText: a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license
ops.newText: a royalty-free, non-exclusive, worldwide, perpetual and irrevocable license

ops.text: (e) Company retains all right, title and interest in and to all data, content, materials, software and other intellectual property provided or made available by Company, or generated for or on behalf of Company, in connection with the Services ("Company Data"), and nothing in this Agreement operates as an assignment, transfer or licence (other than a licence to Contractor to use Company Data solely as necessary to perform the Services) of any Company Data or Company intellectual property to Contractor. Nothing in this Agreement creates joint ownership of the Works or Company Data.
